title: Chapter 80 The Status Quo Of The Territory
content:
Chapter 80 The Status Quo Of The Territory

At this moment, Cao Cao and the others were also dumbfounded, looking at the devastating scene in front of them with expressions of horror and horror.

I believe that even if they will experience it in the future, even if they destroy a world with their own hands, it will not be able to bring them the shocking feeling at this moment.

That was the first time they came into contact with this otherworldly power, which surpassed all mortals, and what was destroyed was their own hometown, the parallel world of the Three Kingdoms.

His eyes slowly retracted, gradually gaining focus, and he turned his head to look at the man standing in the supreme position in front of them.

His Majesty, whom they were about to swear allegiance to the death at this moment, was the devil who had destroyed their hometown, which made them feel very complicated.

I look forward to the life of following that majesty to fight in various worlds, and I am grateful to that majesty for taking me out of this disaster and gaining the chance to survive, but I also resent that majesty for destroying them and growing the world for a lifetime, and I will never return Come.

To use an idiom to describe their mood at the moment, it probably has mixed flavors, everything, like a big messy dye vat, soaking their hearts with colors over and over again.

However, the man they were thinking about very much at the moment, just glanced at them, then withdrew their eyes and stopped thinking about them.

This is a hurdle, and if they can pass it, it means that they are qualified to go on with them. If they still resent themselves, it means that their minds are messed up and not smart enough. Even if they follow themselves, they are just a mess. Harmless.

What he should be thinking at this moment is how is the main world's own territory now? Five years have passed, even if the time ratio is 100:1, the time has passed, he is about 20 days.

For such a long time, for a nascent territory, without a lord to preside over the affairs, it is easy to cause trouble.

I just don't know if anyone has seen me leave for a long time and have been missing. My brain is hot, and I want to jump out and be the master of my own house. That is not a fun thing, if it really happened, then after I come back, I will definitely let him know what is the real king of Yu Kingdom.

However, these are some clowns, not what Zhong Yu is really worried about. What he is worried about is those barbarian tribes. After such a long time, have they found any abnormalities?

Although I was full of confidence when I left, I always thought that it was impossible for anyone to find me, but that was just the psychological comfort I gave myself.

When a person is in trouble, especially if there is no one to share the emotions in his heart, he can only comfort himself. If he even gives up on himself, then there is really no hope for that person.

Therefore, although I think that I have a territory in my heart, there should be no problems for the time being. With the operational efficiency of those barbarian tribes.

Even if he finds out that there is a rebellion in his rear and wants to send troops to wipe it out, it will take him a month of mobilization time! Zhong Yu comforted himself like this in his heart.

However, the worrying time in his heart didn't last too long. After the system absorbed the savings of the Three Kingdoms World, an endless golden light was released in his body world, covering everyone in the entire Three Kingdoms World.

These golden lights are luck points, which are used to make up for their lack of foundation. The golden lights are injected into their bodies, making their bodies warm, and they feel a burst of satisfaction in their hearts.

After a while, the golden light dissipated, and at the same time Zhong Yu looked at the lucky point in his mind with distress, the number dropped from his 1.5 million to 300,000, and his heart ached.

Suddenly lost this kind of warmth, countless pores all over the body opened, enjoying the feeling of the golden light touching, all the people were lost for a while after waking up, without words for a long time, recalling the intoxicating feeling just now enjoy.

Glancing at them, Zhong Yu said to the system: "System, return to the main world!" As soon as the words fell, the white light of the system lit up, and the main body disappeared into the black void of the universe with a flash.

In the main world, Luoyang City was surrounded by a tense atmosphere at this time. All pedestrians were in a hurry. After finishing the tasks they arranged, they returned home in a hurry, closed the door tightly, and dared not go out.

The streets in the entire city were also put under martial law, and teams of soldiers patrolled the city, checking for abnormalities in various places, so as to prevent the entire Luoyang city from causing riots due to certain turmoil.

As for the meeting place in the county government hall in the city, the county magistrate Zhao Xin and the county lieutenant Zhang Lie are summoning officials at all levels in the city at this moment. This is not the first time.

Since the spies patrolling the border reported three days ago, it was found that barbarians often entered and left the border of Luoyang territory, often hiding far away from the village to investigate.

Both Zhao Xin and Zhang Lie understood that the new force in Luoyang City had already been known by the surrounding tribes. After all, even if each tribe does not communicate with each other, they will always meet when hunting.

Now, for half a month, they haven't encountered a single person from the surrounding tribes while hunting. Whether it is for the safety of the tribe, or to see if the tribe around has migrated, Chinese tribes always send people to take a look.

Therefore, even though those spies were killed batch after batch, they couldn't stand Luoyang. The frontier was too big, with a length of tens of miles, and there were hundreds of small tribes connected to him.

Without Zhong Yu guarding the city of Luoyang, Zhao Xin and Zhang Lie dared not lead troops to go out to wipe out those small tribes in order to cover up the news of their exposure.

I'm afraid that if I make a mistake and bring Luoyang City, a new force, into a place where there will be no redemption, then I will be an unforgivable sinner of the Yu Kingdom.

Therefore, we can only kill those who investigate as much as possible, and all the people in the entire imperial kingdom are gathered, and the army is dispatched to implement military control, in case there are strange and unknown people lurking.

At the same time, various troops were summoned to go to key intersections in the frontier and set up checkpoints to prevent the possible attacks of those small tribe enemies.

In this way, three days passed, and three days after the entire tribe was discovered, there was no major disturbance. But we can't take it lightly, so the county magistrate and county lieutenant called the officials in the city every day.

Discuss countermeasures together in the county government, hoping to have a relatively complete strategy that can help them persist until the return of the lord.

According to what the lord said, this time he will be away for a month, and now it has been twenty days. In the last ten days, people like me have to stick to it no matter what.

You can't let down the lord, and you can't live up to the responsibility of guarding the land given to them, and the kindness of the lord.

So they gritted their teeth and persisted, doing everything they could think of every day to maintain the stable operation of this territory.

Due to their effective and rapid administration, although the people in the territory were a little scared, they were not too panicked and nervous, and the most basic production and life could still be maintained.

However, today, they don't need to live in such a tense way anymore, because their emperor, His Majesty, is taking him from another world at this moment.

The recruited elite soldiers and powerful generals, strategic civil servants have returned to this main world, and are about to start another great cause of his conquest.
